dossier.summary: Crestline Outdoor Co. wholesales camping and climbing gear to 900 independent retailers from its headquarters in Austin. The sales team of 14 reviews its pipeline every Monday.
dossier.why_now: Added a second sales region this quarter.

data.title: Pipeline reviews in 20 minutes
data.subtitle: How sales managers at consumer brands and wholesalers cut the weekly pipeline review to 20 minutes with the same deals on the table. Two short talks, then your questions.
